questions.stem_text:
Suppose the government seeks to achieve a balanced budgetby levying taxes of $100 billion
and making expendituresof $100 billion. How will this affect NNP if MPC = 0.8?

options.D: No change in NNP because taxes cancel out expenditures

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Decrease of $500 billion in NNP

questions.stem_text:
In what ways is contractionary fiscal policy in the United States likely to affect
domestic interest rates and the international value of the dollar?

options.A: Interest rates increase and the dollar depreciates.
options.B: Interest rates remain the same and the dollar depreciates.
options.C: Interest rates decrease and the dollar appreciates.
options.D: Interest rates and the value of the dollar both remain the same.
options.E: Interest rates increase but the value of the dollar remains the same.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Interest rates increase and the dollar depreciates.

questions.stem_text:
For a competitive firm, what is the most important thing to consider in deciding whether
to shut down in the short run?

options.A: Do not produce if the TFC is not covered by revenue.
options.B: Do not produce if the price is lower than AVC.
options.E: Shut down if the firm is not making a profit.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Compare AVC to MR.

questions.stem_text:
A competitive market for coffee, a normal good, is currently in equilibrium. Which of the
following would most likely result in an increase in the demand for coffee?

options.A: The price of coffee machines rises.
options.B: The wage of coffee plantation workers falls.
options.D: A decrease in the popularity of energy drinks.
options.E: Technology in the harvesting of coffee beans improves.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The price of tea rises.

questions.stem_text: Why are slight differences in growth rate percentages so important?

options.A: They signify shifts in currency exchange rates
options.B: They are indicative of immediate changes in consumer confidence
options.C: They determine the exact size of the workforce

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - They signify shifts in currency exchange rates
